verdict.rationale: mParticle documents data flows that run continuously once configured. Audiences connected to outputs keep activating downstream (x2), Warehouse Sync ingests from Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery and Databricks (x4), and consent-based forwarding rules apply automatically (x3). Marketing copy also describes AI that turns a stated goal into audience or journey logic and predictive scores that trigger activation (docs-15, docs-22). These are background data pipelines rather than a general automation or agent builder, and the AI features are only vendor marketing. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose automation/workflow builder, scheduling or trigger configuration docs, autonomous agent execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
